name: Widescreen
summary: See more of the track: 16:10, 16:9 or 21:9 instead of the DS's 4:3, with the HUD kept in the middle.
description:
Draws the 3D screen wider, so the view extends to the left and right at the same height (no stretching, no zoom). The game already computes the scenery beyond the DS's screen edges; the GPU renderer now keeps it.

Choose the shape in the in-game menu (F10, Display tab) or with `Widescreen = 16:9` in settings.txt: Off, 16:10, 16:9 or 21:9. For a full-width TV picture, also turn on Single screen. The touch screen keeps its 4:3 picture, centred.

Map overlay (1.1): show the touch screen (race positions and map) small in the bottom-right corner of the 3D screen, so you can play on one widescreen screen. Turn it on in F10 or press F9; size and opacity are adjustable.

Track style (new in 1.2): only the course map's track outline, the racers' heads and the timer, floating over the 3D view with the background left out. Click the map once to switch the game to its whole-course view (clicking the overlay taps the touch screen). F9 cycles Off, Picture and Track.

Known limits: the game hides some objects (karts, items, scenery props) when they leave its own 4:3 view, so they may appear late at the far edges. The HUD and menus stay 4:3 in the middle. Needs the GPU renderer.
